hardening: The guard's negation lookbehind does not compose with the re- prefix the same regex offers: never re-writes the `CI` line matches, because the engine restarts after the prefix. Nothing in the tree hits it today, and a supersede note in that shape would fail the pi-legion lane with no explanation. (?<!\b(?:never|no longer|not)\s(?:re-)?) closes it.

skills/legion-worker/references/review-threads.md:41-42 and the same sentence in prompts/roles/reviewer.md offer --slurp beside commands that elsewhere use --jq; gh refuses the two together.
